list.name: Flag flips

description: The sale as the business sees it: checkouts, payments, the PSP, money, coupons, inventory and hot-SKU stock, plus the edge defences (rate limiting, load shedding, bot protection, waiting room).

panels.title: Checkouts by result
panels.description: Checkout attempts per minute. created = order created and stock reserved. out_of_stock and coupon_exhausted are correct answers once stock/coupons run out; error is not. duplicate_replayed / in_progress are idempotency at work.

panels.title: Payments by result
panels.description: Payment attempts per minute. timeout is the dangerous one: the PSP may have charged anyway (lab payment-limbo). pending = waiting for the reconciler. replayed = idempotent replay of an earlier attempt.

panels.title: PSP charges by result
panels.description: What the payment provider saw. idempotent_replay = the PSP recognised a retry and did not charge twice. outage and rate_limited are provider-side failures (not customer declines).

panels.title: Money: GMV vs charged by the PSP
panels.description: Rupees per minute. GMV counts paid orders; 'charged' counts what the PSP actually took. If charged runs above GMV, customers are paying for orders we do not consider paid (double charges, orphan charges).

panels.title: Orders by status
panels.description: All orders in the database by status (control-plane). Watch PAYMENT_PENDING and PAYMENT_IN_PROGRESS: they must drain.

panels.title: Reconciler outcomes
panels.description: Pending payments resolved by asking the PSP for the truth: paid, failed, still_unknown, error.

panels.title: Coupon redemptions
panels.description: Coupon redemption attempts per minute by result (ok, exhausted). With check_then_act more than the cap can succeed under concurrency — compare with the integrity check. Lab: coupon-overrun.

panels.title: Coupons redeemed in range
panels.description: Successful coupon redemptions in the selected time range.

panels.title: Reservations by strategy and result
panels.description: Stock reservation attempts per second. strategy is the inventory.reserve flag mode. deadlock results come from multi-item carts locking rows in different orders (lab deadlocks).

panels.title: Reservation latency
panels.description: p50 and p99 reservation time by strategy. select_for_update serializes buyers of the same hot SKU on a row lock, so p99 grows with concurrency; atomic_conditional_update and redis_lua stay flat. Lab: oversell-race.

panels.title: Hot SKU available units
panels.description: Available units of the flash-deal SKUs over time. Below the dashed zero line = oversold (lab oversell-race). Stuck above zero while the storefront says 'sold out' = units held by abandoned reservations (lab phantom-sellout).

panels.title: Hot SKU stock now
panels.description: Current available units per hot SKU. Red = 0 or negative.

panels.title: Expired reservations
panels.description: Unpaid reservations released by the TTL sweeper per minute (inventory.reservationTtl=expire_and_sweep). Zero during a sale with many abandoned checkouts means stock is leaking into phantom holds.

panels.title: Rate limiter decisions
panels.description: allowed / limited (429) / error_allowed (Redis down, failing open) / error_rejected (Redis down, failing closed — a Redis blip becomes an outage). Labs: rate-limit-bursts, redis-blip.

panels.title: Load shed by priority
panels.description: Requests rejected with 503 OVERLOADED by priority. Low (search, categories) goes first at 50% of gatewayMaxInflight, normal at 75%, high at 90%, critical (checkout, pay, queue) only at 100%. Lab: overload-collapse.

panels.title: Bot blocks by reason
panels.description: Requests blocked as bots: no_product_view / too_fast (add-to-cart on a hot SKU without viewing it for 1.5s), fresh_account (token younger than 3s), checkout_velocity (more than 6 checkouts a minute). Lab: bot-army.

panels.title: Waiting room queue
panels.description: Users waiting for a checkout pass. The queue should rise at sale start and drain at waitingRoomAdmitPerSec. Lab: thundering-herd.

panels.title: Waiting room admissions
panels.description: Passes issued per second (admitted) and checkouts rejected for a missing/expired pass (rejected — QUEUE_REQUIRED, the client must join the queue).

panels.title: Guest sessions created
panels.description: New guest tokens per second — a proxy for arrivals. Bots often create many fresh accounts.
